question: In a certain code language, PHONE is coded as 78 and MOON is coded as 52. How will PLAN be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

Sum of opposite alphabet positional value +1.

PHONE is coded as 78.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcca34df272ed2a07178aa22b7f6932033078b23deee491b4bf0ce4f0d5ab90d.png] 

= (11 + 19 + 12 + 13 + 22) + 1

= 77 + 1

= 78</
